notes: Open is treated as on and closed as off. Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible; the two separately hinged upper-cabinet leaves are reported as separate events even though their open intervals overlap. Their closing actions are compressed into the 552–560 sampling interval, so both off midpoints are approximately frame 556.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of a galley kitchen, followed by manipulation of two countertop drawers and the two separate doors of the upper cabinet above the range hood.
